evidence: A long-time user praises on-device speech recognition accuracy and says they love the keyboard. Their edit clarifies that its license is source-available rather than open-source.

evidence_sources.author: rpdillon
evidence_sources.excerpt: FUTO keyboard (open-source, free) runs entirely on-device and has extremely good STT accurary, especially with the 70M parameter model. I've used it for years now and love it.

evidence_sources.author: robertlane0
evidence_sources.excerpt: I'd classify it as "source-available" given the noncommercial clause in the license.
